verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it ships browser-control capability. The axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions browser automation, navigation, login or page extraction. Generic tool registration (adding tools to an agent constructor) is only a developer building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
